source_audit_note: Exact B1 message/exception reviewed in the HBase 2.6.6 source; 128 effective trials reached B1 after the last fault and selected exception count is zero. RPC-only I/O scope and production procedure-store abort behavior are documented in README.

source_review: The original JUnit reached AssignmentManager.preTransitCheck B1 four times with regionNode.getProcedure()==null. It intentionally encountered B2 DoNotRetryRegionException on both move operations; B3 was evaluated false at the earlier unassign/assign checks, while the final move was preempted by B2. Across 128 exact, target-retaining fault trials, B1 never threw its selected HBaseIOException. The 79 JUnit failures under injected RPC faults do not establish a B1 defect.

instrumentation_provenance.coverage: JaCoCo production probes for AssignmentManager, RegionStateNode, TransitRegionStateProcedure, MasterRpcServices, HBaseAdmin, RpcRetryingCallerImpl, MasterCallable, AbstractRpcClient

completion_review: Original TestRegionMove.testDisableAndMove reached the exact selected check after 128 fully matched RPC I/O fault sequences; one partially applied and target-losing trial gf_0083 is excluded from the effective budget. No confirmed new bug at this check.
io_scope_note: Workload MasterService RPC request/response I/O only. In HBase 2.6.6, procedure persistence writes pass through RegionProcedureStore and MasterRegion.update0; ordinary IOException there aborts the active master, removing the check from this single-master JUnit. No synthetic outer-method file fault was counted.
